name: Commerce ePayco
description: Drupal Commerce integration for ePayco: off-site (standard) and on-page (iframe) payment gateways, per-store credential overrides, a cron/Drush pending-payment reconciler, and a hook to alter outbound checkout data.
project_description: Commerce ePayco is the Drupal Commerce integration submodule of the ePayco project. It provides two off-site payment gateway plugins — ePayco (Standard checkout), which redirects to ePayco's secure checkout, and ePayco (One page checkout), which opens ePayco's checkout modal/iframe. Each gateway references an ePayco factory (account settings) and can be overridden per store so individual sellers use their own ePayco account. It adds a hook to alter outbound checkout data, a cron job and a Drush command to reconcile pending payments against ePayco's API, and store base fields for per-store credentials.
